lines.en: I close my bell, then open it.
The sea pushes me along.
My tentacles drag along behind.
Lavender spreads through the water.
I do not swim; I simply drift.
In the school, I take the middle.

lines.zh: 光从上面漏下来，我发白。
lines.en: Light leaks down; I turn white.
I open and close, over and over.
The deeper it gets, the brighter I am.
My tentacles brush the seagrass tips.
I turn the rim of my bell slowly.
The current bends; I bend with it.
My blue rim glints in the water.
Pulse by pulse, I travel far.

lines.zh: 我一张一合，随暖流上浮。
lines.en: Pulse by pulse, I drift up the warm current.

lines.zh: 伞沿一翻，我换了个方向。
lines.en: My bell folds once, and I change direction.

lines.zh: 我浮在原处，伞盖几乎不动。
lines.en: I float in place, bell barely stirring.
My bell swells and sinks with breath.
Purple tentacles hang like thread.
The fish go around me.
I wait for the light before dusk.
The sea is cold; I feel warm.

lines.zh: 我的身体几乎是透明的。
lines.en: My body is almost transparent.
There is a boat shadow overhead.
I am in no hurry; nor is the sea.

lines.zh: 触须碰到石头，缩了一下。
lines.en: A tentacle touched stone and recoiled.

lines.zh: 我数着从伞边游过的鱼。
lines.en: I count the fish passing my bell rim.
A ring of light spreads beside me.
It is quiet enough to hear the water.
I let myself fade a little more.
You are in the water; I see you clearly.
Your armor throws the light back.
I lift my bell rim to look.
You swim too fast.

lines.zh: 我的触须朝你伸了一点。
lines.en: My tentacle reaches a little toward you.
You are carrying an empty bucket.
Do not touch me; my tentacles sting.
I know the warmth of people.

lines.zh: 你看着我，我的伞盖朝你转。
lines.en: You watch me; my bell turns toward you.
Your bubbles are running upward.
A corner of my bell is torn.
Do not squeeze; I have four health.
Two of my tentacles snapped.
I fold myself into a tiny ball.
The water suddenly went cloudy.

lines.zh: 一下就把我的伞盖打散了。
lines.en: One blow scattered my bell apart.
My blue rim dimmed.
It hurts so much I forgot to close.
I am soft and cannot drift.
My light is on your hand.
That light in your hand; I follow.
What is that blue thing?
You swing the bucket; the water moves.
I should back away, but I want closer.
Something is shining in the water.
Your lamp is making me dizzy.
A little more, and I will touch you.
I hear the water inside your bucket.
This light made me forget to hide.
Do not go; I have not seen enough.
Who scattered my tentacles?
Your arm passed right through me.
The current pressed me to the rock.
We jostle against each other in the school.
My bell rim dented a little.
Do not bump me with the bucket.
That sent me spinning three times.
A fish fell into me and fled.
I am too soft; a touch deforms me.
A tentacle caught around your ankle.

lines.zh: 两只伞盖贴着，一起呼吸。
lines.en: Two bells touch and breathe together.
Our blue rims join into one line.
Its tentacles are longer than mine.
In the school, I follow only it.
It closes its bell; I close mine.

lines.zh: 水里两团淡紫，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: Two pale purple shapes drift closer.
Side by side, we drift without a word.
Its light falls across my bell.
Drifting like this, I am not alone.
It moves a step; I move a step.

lines.zh: 我捞住一粒发光的东西。
lines.en: I catch a small glowing thing.
A tentacle curls around a shell flake.
I will keep this little crumb.
It sank from above; it is mine.
I caught it with my bell.
So tiny my tentacle almost loses it.
I pass it toward my mouth arms.
Not food, yet I insist on keeping it.
You dropped it; it drifted to me.
I hold it and keep drifting.
Warmth is coming through the water.

lines.zh: 我看见一只脚踩进浅滩。
lines.en: I see a foot step into the shallows.
That shadow is sinking lower.
Something touched my tentacle.
The light changed; someone is here.
It swims urgently, not like a fish.
I turn, bell rim pointed down.
I know the gleam of a bucket.
The one above has stopped.
My tentacle reaches out by itself.
I sink slowly and follow you.
My tentacles spread by your feet.
You retreat; I drift closer.
I am not fast, but you cannot dodge.
The whole school faces one way.

lines.zh: 我的蓝边贴上了你的护甲。
lines.en: My blue rim touches your armor.
One inch more and we touch.
I go around the seagrass and keep on.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我正贴在你身后。
lines.en: Turn around; I am right behind you.
The water pushes us together.
My tentacle sweeps across your hand.
It does not hurt, only numbs.
You will glow; do not blame me.
I press close and your strength slips.
The numbness climbs up from your wrist.
I only touched you once.

lines.zh: 你的力气被我抽走一点。
lines.en: I drew a little strength out of you.
That light will stay with you a while.
I pull back; you are still shaking.
Do not grab me; I sting.

lines.zh: 我在深海的暗处张开伞。
lines.en: I open my bell in the deep dark.

lines.zh: 天亮了，光却照不到这里。
lines.en: Day came, but the light misses here.
Three others rise beside me.
I scatter out of a spawn egg.
The seawater is cold, which suits me.
Four of us, four directions.
My first close of the bell is slow.
That blue above is the surface.

lines.zh: 我出生在没有光的水层。
lines.en: I was born in a lightless layer.

lines.zh: 触须还没长齐，我先漂着。
lines.en: My tentacles are short; I drift first.

lines.zh: 热水烫过伞盖，我卷起来。
lines.en: Hot water washed my bell; it curled.

lines.zh: 我被摔在礁石上，摊成一片。
lines.en: I hit the reef and spread out flat.

lines.zh: 我离了水，伞盖贴在沙上。
lines.en: Out of water, my bell sticks to the sand.
The blast tore me into pieces.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，我漏了一点光。
lines.en: An arrow passed through, leaking light.
That light tangled around my tentacles.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到浮游，我发白。
lines.en: No plankton for too long; I turn pale.

lines.zh: 雷劈进海面，我亮得像灯。
lines.en: Lightning hit the sea; I shone like a lamp.

lines.zh: 黑水下面，我散成一点光。
lines.en: In the black water I scatter into light.
